name: Trailer Editor
description: Edit YouTube trailers directly in the Jellyfin movie metadata editor.
overview: Adds a YouTube trailer field to the existing metadata dialog. Saves through Jellyfin's native metadata pipeline; NFO output requires the NFO saver.
